sql: SELECT id, status, title, body FROM article WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR title CONTAINS 'kill' OR title CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, status, title, published_at, body FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'];
SELECT id, kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT parent, count() FROM passage GROUP BY parent;
SELECT id, status, ->covers->topic AS topics FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04';
SELECT title, count() AS c FROM article GROUP BY title HAVING c > 1;
SELECT title, count() AS c FROM article GROUP BY title;
